words.definition: a person who replies to a survey or questionnaire
words.example: Most respondents said they preferred remote work options.
words.exampleTranslation: 大多數受訪者表示他們偏好遠距工作選項。
words.note: 動詞形：respond (v.) 回應，名詞另有 response（回覆；回應內容）

words.definition: ornamental items worn for decoration, such as rings and necklaces
words.example: The store's jewelry display was updated for the holiday season.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家店的珠寶展示櫃為了節慶季節更新過了。
words.note: 不可數名詞，沒有複數形 jewelries，強調數量時用 a piece of jewelry

words.definition: time worked beyond one's normal working hours
words.example: Staff will receive extra pay for any overtime this week.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工這週的任何加班時數都會獲得額外薪資。
words.note: 常用片語 work overtime（加班）

words.definition: a device that stores and supplies electrical power
words.example: Please replace the battery in the conference room remote.
words.exampleTranslation: 請更換會議室遙控器的電池。
words.note: 常見片語 battery life（電池續航力）

words.definition: to give money or goods to help a person or cause
words.example: The company encourages employees to donate to local charities.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司鼓勵員工捐款給當地慈善機構。
words.note: 相關詞：donation (n.) 捐款/捐贈物，donor (n.) 捐贈者

words.definition: exceptionally good, or (of a debt) not yet paid
words.example: Please settle any outstanding invoices before the end of the fiscal year.
words.exampleTranslation: 請在會計年度結束前清償任何未償付的請款單。
words.note: 財務情境中常指「尚未清償的」，例如 outstanding balance，非「傑出的」那個意思

words.definition: to read something quickly without focusing on every detail
words.example: I only had time to skim the report before the meeting.
words.exampleTranslation: 我在會議前只有時間快速瀏覽這份報告。
words.note: 常用片語 skim through（快速略讀過一遍）

words.definition: a flat rectangular case for carrying documents, used mainly for business
words.example: He left his briefcase with the contracts on the train.
words.exampleTranslation: 他把裝著合約的公事包忘在火車上了。
words.note: 字源：brief（摘要文件）＋ case（箱子）組成，原指裝法律文件的公事包

words.definition: a sweet dish served after the main course of a meal
words.example: The banquet menu includes three dessert options.
words.exampleTranslation: 宴會菜單提供三種甜點選擇。
words.note: 拼字常與 desert（沙漠；遺棄）搞混，記憶法：dessert 雙寫 s

words.definition: a strong effect or influence
words.example: The new policy will have a major impact on shipping costs.
words.exampleTranslation: 這項新政策將對運費造成重大影響。
words.note: 常用片語 have an impact on（對……造成影響）

words.definition: featuring new ideas or methods; original and creative
words.example: The startup is known for its innovative approach to logistics.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家新創公司以創新的物流方式聞名。
words.note: 相關詞：innovate (v.) 創新，innovation (n.) 創新（作為）

words.definition: to ask for information about something
words.example: Feel free to inquire about our group discount rates.
words.exampleTranslation: 歡迎隨時詢問我們的團體優惠價格。
words.note: 名詞形：inquiry (n.) 詢問；查詢，英式拼法也可寫成 enquire/enquiry

words.definition: during the night, or happening very quickly
words.example: The documents were sent overnight to arrive by tomorrow morning.
words.exampleTranslation: 這些文件透過連夜快遞寄出，明天早上就會送達。
words.note: 也可作形容詞，例如 an overnight stay（過夜住宿）

words.definition: the place where an event or meeting is held
words.example: We booked a larger venue to accommodate all the guests.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們訂了一個更大的場地來容納所有賓客。
words.note: 常用片語 book a venue（預訂場地）

words.definition: a person who regularly travels between home and work
words.example: Commuters can save money with a monthly train pass.
words.exampleTranslation: 通勤者可以透過月票省下不少交通費。
words.note: 動詞形：commute (v.) 通勤，例如 She commutes by train every day。

words.definition: a symbol or design used by a company to identify its products
words.example: The new logo will appear on all packaging starting next quarter.
words.exampleTranslation: 新的商標將從下一季開始出現在所有包裝上。
words.note: 複數形直接加 s，logos，不是 logoes

words.definition: a printed or digital report sent regularly to members or subscribers
words.example: Subscribe to our newsletter for monthly industry updates.
words.exampleTranslation: 訂閱我們的電子報以獲得每月產業動態。
words.note: 常見於 email newsletter（電子報）這個固定搭配

words.definition: a person who gives expert guidance or recommendations
words.example: A financial advisor reviewed the company's investment plan.
words.exampleTranslation: 一位財務顧問審核了公司的投資計畫。
words.note: 拼法也可寫成 adviser，兩者皆常見

words.definition: a removable container holding ink, toner, or other material for a device
words.example: Order a new printer cartridge before this one runs out.
words.exampleTranslation: 在墨水匣用完之前先訂購一個新的。
words.note: 常見於 cartridge razor（拋棄式刀頭刮鬍刀）這類複合詞

words.definition: covered with clouds; not sunny
words.example: It will be cloudy with a chance of rain during the outdoor tour.
words.exampleTranslation: 戶外導覽期間預計是多雲天氣，並有機會下雨。
words.note: 同類天氣形容詞字尾模式：rain→rainy，sun→sunny
